title: QUIC RFC 9000 STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P13 requirement-home tests, Release build, QuicFrameCodec benchmark Dry run, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED parser and formatter behavior, type 0x15 fixed-frame encoding, Stream ID and Maximum Stream Data variable-length integer handling, frame-boundary consumption, blocked-stream identity preservation, and blocked-offset preservation for RFC 9000 Section 19.13 requirements 0003 through 0008.
expected_result: Focused S19P13 requirement homes prove that STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frames use the fixed type 0x15, reject non-minimal type encodings, preserve and format Stream ID and Maximum Stream Data varint fields across width boundaries, reject truncated or out-of-range field encodings, and consume only the STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame bytes.
procedure: Run the focused S19P13 requirement-home filter.
Run the QuicFrameCodec STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED benchmark methods with BenchmarkDotNet Dry job.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing QuicFrameCodec STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED parser and formatter are the wire-format seam under test.
The existing QuicStreamDataBlockedFrame immutable view remains the field carrier under test.
Runtime advisory emission remains owned by the existing STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED runtime artifact family.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim new STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED emission scheduling, flow-control autotuning, asynchronous credit waiting, sender/recovery behavior, public flow-control APIs, send-only stream receive termination, or hosted endpoint close-packet behavior beyond the parser and formatter seams.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. Regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S19P13-0003 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S19P13-0008 as trace_clean with fuzz required and no missing required coverage. Release build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Focused S19P13 requirement-home tests passed 35/35. SpecTrace core validation passed for 400 JSON artifacts. BenchmarkDotNet Dry smoke executed ParseStreamDataBlockedFrame and FormatStreamDataBlockedFrame. git diff --check passed.
